subject: Bullying Prevention and Intervention Plan Revision
overview: The subcommittee reviewed a consolidated draft of the district's bullying policy, focusing on simplifying the document and clarifying the distinction between peer conflict and bullying. The body approved a timeline for final administrative review to prepare the policy for a first reading by the full School Committee.

items.title: Revised Policy Overview
items.summary: Member Graham presented a streamlined version of the bullying prevention and intervention plan, reducing the document from 35 pages to 13 while integrating legal feedback and social-emotional learning components.

items.title: Definitions of Bullying and Conflict
items.summary: The subcommittee refined policy definitions to distinguish between bullying, characterized by repeated abuse and power imbalances, and peer conflict involving equal-power quarrels.

items.title: Reporting and Athletics Oversight
items.summary: Members discussed investigator roles for incidents involving athletics and established that an official investigation should commence once minimum criteria are met, regardless of whether formal reporting forms are completed.

items.title: Investigation and Documentation Standards
items.summary: The subcommittee reviewed investigative timelines and record-keeping requirements, including a decision to strike a provision that allowed staff to keep personal notes indefinitely.

items.title: Administrative Review and Finalization
items.summary: The subcommittee approved a motion for Member Graham to update the draft for the Superintendent's review by May 26 to determine if the policy is ready for a first reading on June 5.
